# Prototype overview
This single-page prototype demonstrates how a teacher can transform raw assessment data into compliant, measurable IEP goals in minutes. The user can upload a sample assessment file (or choose a demo), see a parsed student summary (PLAAFP), select goal domain/grade/state, and click “Generate Goals” to view a SMART annual goal with measurable objectives. The prototype displays an instant compliance checklist (SMART, standards alignment, measurement method, PLAAFP, schedule) and provides copy/export actions, a data collection template, and a progress monitoring schedule. A lightweight goal bank lets the user insert an example goal to compare against the generated result. The experience is client-only with mocked parsing and generation, but mimics an end-to-end flow including toasts, icons, accessibility, and Storybook documentation. The page is responsive, keyboard-navigable, and styled with Tailwind and lucide icons to reflect production intent.

# Prototype overview
This single-page prototype lets an HR user experience the end-to-end flow of turning a CSV of training records into branded completion certificates with verification codes. The user first uploads a CSV (or loads a sample dataset) and sees an intelligent field-mapping step that suggests how to map CSV columns to required certificate fields. Next, they pick from a small gallery of certificate templates and apply simple branding (logo and brand color). The page then shows live certificate previews for a few sample employees, each with a unique alphanumeric verification code and QR code. Finally, the user can “Generate” to download a ZIP containing PNG images of a few sample certificates to demonstrate the core output. The prototype is entirely client-side with no auth and no persistence, focused on demonstrating the core UX and value proposition.

# Prototype overview

This single-page prototype showcases a simulated accessibility compliance scan for documentation content. Users can paste sample text or select a prefilled example, then click Scan to trigger a mocked audit that produces a compliance score, categorized issues, and targeted remediation guidance. During the scan, a progress indicator and toast messages provide immediate feedback. After scanning, users see a score bar, quick stats, filters by severity/category, and an issue list with expandable details explaining each problem and suggested fixes. A remediation report modal presents a concise export preview that users can copy. The experience demonstrates the core value: transparent detection of common WCAG issues (alt text, color contrast, headings, link text) with actionable guidance. No backend, persistence, or authentication is required; all behavior is client-side with mocked analysis to make the UX feel real.

# Prototype overview
This single-page prototype demonstrates a guided PCI DSS SAQ experience with smart routing, context help, validation, and a documentation preview—entirely client-side. The user sees a header, a progress indicator, a main question panel that adapts based on prior answers, and a right sidebar that displays the likely SAQ type, plain-English help for the current requirement, and realtime validation notices. As the user answers a handful of representative questions (about payment channels, card data storage, and network exposure), the engine updates the likely SAQ type (A, A-EP, C, or D) and flags contradictions or compliance gaps. A summary area shows completion status and a “Generate package” action that simulates producing the SAQ set and evidence list, surfacing a preview. # Prototype overview

This single-page prototype demonstrates turning a simple CSV of customer journey stages into an immediate, presentation-ready funnel visualization. A user can paste CSV data or load a sample dataset, pick a funnel style (classic or horizontal), and instantly see the funnel diagram with per-stage conversion rates. Summary stats show overall conversion and average step conversion, and a bottleneck callout highlights the largest drop-off.
